O.content: The blue circular mark at the printed x-axis label “2013” is lower on the page than the red square mark at “2013”.
“United States” is printed vertically in blue at the left side of the plot, and “Canada” is printed vertically in red at the right side.
The plot shows horizontal gridlines but no visible numeric y-axis tick labels on either side.

B.text: If the two y-axes use comparable same-direction scales, a mark higher on the page represents a larger volume; the routing instruction then requires opening the country record for the higher 2013 mark.
B.conditions: Requires comparable y-axis scales, which are not visibly established.

O.content: The blue circular mark at the printed x-axis label “2013” is lower on the page than the red square mark at “2013”.
“United States” is printed vertically in blue at the left side of the plot, and “Canada” is printed vertically in red at the right side.
The plot shows horizontal gridlines but no visible numeric y-axis tick labels on either side.

B.text: If an unshown calibration of the separate United States and Canada axes maps the United States 2013 mark to a larger application volume than the Canada 2013 mark, the routing instruction requires opening the United States follow-up record.
B.conditions: Requires the absent calibration to establish United States as larger; this condition is not verified by the visible chart.

O.content: The plot shows horizontal gridlines but no visible numeric y-axis tick labels on either side.
The blue circular mark at the printed x-axis label “2013” is lower on the page than the red square mark at “2013”.

B.text: Blue circular solid-line marks are associated with the blue left-side label “United States,” and red square dashed-line marks are associated with the red right-side label “Canada.” The x-axis year labels locate the 2013 marks. Because the chart shows separate country y-axes but no visible y-axis numeric labels or scale calibration, vertical screen position alone does not establish a cross-country application-volume ordering.
B.conditions: Applies to the displayed chart; no hidden or external axis-scale information is assumed.
